api/src/services/__init__.py.name: Business logic package
api/src/services/__init__.py.description: Groups the business rules that do the platform's real work behind the screens.

api/src/services/deployment_environment..name: Startup settings check
api/src/services/deployment_environment..description: Warns at startup about old or renamed settings still present, so nothing quietly stops taking effect.

api/src/services/durable_impersonation.p.name: Who started background work
api/src/services/durable_impersonation.p.description: Keeps a note of the staff member who started work that runs in the background, so the activity record names the right person.

api/src/services/embed_auth.py.name: Embedded app sign-in check
api/src/services/embed_auth.py.description: Confirms a request from an embedded app is genuine before trusting the customer details it carries.

api/src/services/node_subprocess.py.name: Website build helpers
api/src/services/node_subprocess.py.description: Runs the small helper programs that bundle and style an app's code when that app is built.

api/src/services/openapi_endpoints.py.name: Workflow web addresses
api/src/services/openapi_endpoints.py.description: Turns workflows marked as callable into public web addresses, and keeps that list current as workflows change.

api/src/services/solution_deploy_preflig.name: Solution deploy check
api/src/services/solution_deploy_preflig.description: Checks a solution's workflows before deployment, so a bundle that could never run is rejected up front.

api/src/services/solution_files.py.name: Solution files
api/src/services/solution_files.py.description: Stores and serves the files that belong to an installed solution, kept apart from other customers' files.

api/src/services/solution_scope.py.name: Solution access rules
api/src/services/solution_scope.py.description: Decides which installed solution may reach which stored files and records, including requests between solutions.

api/src/services/table_policy_loader.py.name: Table rule loading
api/src/services/table_policy_loader.py.description: Loads the access rules attached to a table in one place, so every check sees the same rules.
